versions.summary: Baseline at the start of the schema registry (FB-151). Before it, 0.1.0 was edited in place several times, most recently to require time_governance (FB-090); those states are in the repository's history and are not versions. At the baseline every schema took the one id form forge://fxts/<framework>/v<version> and gained integrity.schema_version and integrity.schema_hash.
FB-226: one description names the schema-ref module by its new package, forge_core.schema_ref; nothing a spec is checked against changed

FB-079 (D-8): words for what FACTS could not say about an OT adapter: the OPC UA client services as source types (browse, read, subscribe, history_read, write), the collection mode on_demand, the parameter types enum and object, the enrichment rule opcua_property_read. Additions only.

D-19 step 2 (FB-264): every top-level property carries its evidence mark, x-forge-evidence: claim (says something about the real thing), description (text for people; nothing decides on it) or structure (about the spec as a document). Marks only: what a spec may say is unchanged, so no spec needs review (AE-3).
